_about: Image cards for miniature01. Written by Gemini 3.7 Flash from the source photographs using native vision, before any prompt existed. One card per still. gate1_status records that the card was checked back against the image before it was allowed to be used.
_artwork: Photographs by Lori Nix and Kathleen Gerber. lorinix.net
